Name: Nyapu's RomRas Portrait and Sprite
Author: Necolle
Description:
A small edit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu[/url]'s Young Wizard to be compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073?tab=description]standard Romanceable Rasmodius. 
[/url]
The sprites and portraits is already in CP form and no need to replace any files.

Installation:

1. Download Nyapu's Portraits and Romanceable Rasmodius
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip the folders and drop my mod. 
4. Have fun!!!

[b]!!THIS IS NOT FOR THE SVE VERSION OF ROMANCEABLE RASMODIUS!![/b]

All credits belong to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu/about-me?gameId=1303]Nyapu [/url]for their wonderful art and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/WerewolfMaster/about-me?gameId=1303]WerewolfMaster[/url]﻿ for expanding Rasmodius's story and personality ^^
